verdict.rationale: E2B is fundamentally an SDK/API and CLI for programmatically creating and controlling sandboxes (Sandbox.create(), commands.run(), files API), designed for headless, non-interactive use in code and automation pipelines, with self-hosting/Terraform support for CI infra. No GUI is required for core operation, making it inherently CI/automation-friendly, though some interactivity edge cases were noted in community feedback.
